:::{#def-aft}
#### Accelerated failure time model

An **accelerated failure time (AFT) model**
for an event time $T$ with covariate vector $\vx$
assumes that

$$
\surv(t \mid \vx) \eqdef \surv_0\paren{ t \cdot \hazfactor(\vx) }
$$ {#eq-aft-surv}

where:

- $\surv_0(t) \eqdef \P(T > t \mid \vx = \vzero)$ is the
  [baseline survival function](proportional-hazards-models.qmd#def-baseline-surv), and
- $\hazfactor(\vx)$ is the acceleration factor (@def-acceleration-factor).

:::

::: notes
An acceleration factor $\hazfactor(\vx) > 1$ makes time pass faster
for a subject with covariates $\vx$ than at baseline,
so events happen sooner;
$\hazfactor(\vx) < 1$ slows time down,
so events happen later.
:::
